name: Roasted Carrot-Onion Couscous Bowl with Kale & Turmeric Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and quarter carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the baking sheet with the carrots, drizzle with oil, and season with salt. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium red onions
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are golden brown and tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the veggies are roasting, in a medium saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message:
473 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 cup whole wheat couscous

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice lemon into a small bowl. Add tahini, water, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup tahini
2 tsp honey
1 tsp turmeric, ground
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp black pepper
salt

instructions.primary_message: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl and sprinkle with salt.
Add half of the dressing to the bowl with the kale and, using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes. (Reserve remaining dressing for serving.)
Roughly chop dates. Transfer to a plate.
Crumble goat cheese onto the plate with the dates.
To serve, divide couscous between bowls; top with kale, roasted veggies, dates, and goat cheese. Drizzle with reserved dressing and enjoy!
